title: The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao
author: Junot Díaz
summary: Oscar is a lonely, overweight Dominican American nerd who dreams of love and of writing fantasy. His story is traced through his family's history under the dictator Trujillo and a supposed family curse.
readIf: you like voicey, footnoted novels that mix geek culture with history.
skipIf: you dislike heavy slang, Spanish phrases and a narrator who interrupts the story.
